context_length_note: Seed inputs exactly calibrated to 2048/4096/8192; continuation input counts are explicit and can exceed the seed. No truncation. Output budget 256 is additional.
quality_scope: Strict four-record factual JSON extraction; complements independent code/instruction suites.

comparison_protocol.primary_metric: paired quality-passing total_ms and ttft_text_ms by session
comparison_protocol.statistics: bootstrap session clusters, never individual repetitions
comparison_protocol.engine_order: rotate complete engine blocks per repetition; exclusive GPU
comparison_protocol.warmup: one excluded public dev session per engine before each block
comparison_protocol.reset: restart engines or explicitly clear all KV between blocks
